checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are transaction fields (gas, value, data, to, nonce) immutable in transit between sender and execution engine?

reachability.notes: Transaction integrity is enforced by ECDSA signatures. Any modification invalidates the signature.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Identify all transaction ingestion paths (P2P network, RPC endpoints, mempool). 2. Trace transaction data flow from network receipt to execution engine. 3. Verify ECDSA signature validation occurs BEFORE any transaction field access. 4. Attempt to submit transactions with modified fields (gas, value, data, to, nonce) while preserving original signature - verify rejection. 5. Check for any code paths that deserialize transaction fields before signature verification. 6. Verify transaction hash is computed over the canonical encoding and matches signed hash. 7. Test for signature malleability vulnerabilities (s-value canonicalization, v-value handling). 8. Verify no transaction field interpolation or default value injection occurs post-signature.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0048, Trust Boundary: tb-022. PoC requirement: demonstrate a modified transaction that passes ECDSA signature verification.

checklist.title: Verify ECDSA Signature Coverage: Does the signature cover the complete transaction payload including all mutable fields?

reachability.notes: Transaction integrity is enforced by ECDSA signatures. Any modification invalidates the signature.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Review the transaction signing implementation to identify which fields are included in the signed hash. 2. Verify all critical fields (gas, gasPrice/maxFeePerGas, value, data, to, nonce, chainId) are included in signature. 3. Check for any transaction types (legacy, EIP-1559, EIP-2930, EIP-4844) that may have different signing schemes. 4. Verify accessList (EIP-2930), maxPriorityFeePerGas (EIP-1559), and blob fields (EIP-4844) are properly signed. 5. Test that unsigned metadata fields cannot influence execution behavior. 6. Verify chain ID is included to prevent cross-chain replay attacks.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0048, Supporting check for signature coverage completeness.

checklist.title: Verify Execution Client Transaction Handling: Does the execution client validate transaction integrity before processing?

reachability.notes: Transaction integrity is enforced by ECDSA signatures. Any modification invalidates the signature.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Review execution client's transaction validation pipeline. 2. Verify signature verification is performed before transaction enters mempool. 3. Check that transaction hash is recomputed and verified, not trusted from external sources. 4. Verify sender address is recovered from signature, not accepted as input. 5. Test behavior when receiving transactions with mismatched sender/signature. 6. Verify no caching mechanisms allow stale or modified transactions to bypass verification.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0048, Supporting check for actor-execution-client node.

checklist.title: Verify P2P Transaction Propagation Integrity: Are transactions protected from modification during P2P relay?

reachability.notes: Transaction integrity is enforced by ECDSA signatures. Any modification invalidates the signature.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Review P2P transaction announcement and retrieval protocols. 2. Verify transactions are identified by hash and validated upon receipt. 3. Test behavior when a peer sends a transaction with incorrect hash. 4. Verify transaction validation occurs before storage or forwarding. 5. Check for any transaction pooling mechanisms that could mix fields from different transactions. 6. Test for transaction replacement attacks where modified transactions could substitute originals.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0048, Supporting check for P2P entry point.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are EIP-7702 SetCodeTransaction authorization signatures cryptographically validated before code delegation?

reachability.notes: EIP-7702 allows code delegation for EOAs. Weak authorization validation enables account takeover.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Identify the EIP-7702 authorization processing entry point in the execution client. 2. Review ECDSA signature verification logic for each authorization tuple. 3. Verify that the recovered signer address matches the authorizing account address. 4. Attempt to submit a SetCodeTransaction with a forged or malformed signature and verify rejection. 5. Test with truncated signatures, invalid v/r/s values, and signatures from different accounts. 6. Verify that authorization signatures are checked BEFORE any code delegation state changes occur.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0049, Trust Boundary: tb-022 (transaction boundary for SetCode). Pre-condition: Each authorization MUST be individually signed by the authorizing account.

checklist.title: Verify EIP-7702 Authorization Chain ID Validation Prevents Cross-Chain Replay Attacks

reachability.notes: EIP-7702 allows code delegation for EOAs. Weak authorization validation enables account takeover.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Locate chain_id validation logic within EIP-7702 authorization processing. 2. Verify that the authorization's chain_id is checked against the current network's chain_id. 3. Attempt to replay a valid authorization from a different chain (e.g., testnet authorization on mainnet). 4. Test with chain_id=0 (wildcard) and verify expected behavior per EIP-7702 specification. 5. Verify rejection of authorizations with mismatched chain_id values.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0049, Trust Boundary: tb-022. Chain ID validation is critical to prevent cross-chain authorization replay.

checklist.title: Verify EIP-7702 Authorization Nonce Validation Prevents Replay Within Same Chain

reachability.notes: EIP-7702 allows code delegation for EOAs. Weak authorization validation enables account takeover.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Locate nonce validation logic within EIP-7702 authorization processing. 2. Verify that authorization nonces are checked against the authorizing account's current nonce. 3. Attempt to replay a previously used authorization and verify rejection. 4. Test with nonces that are too high, too low, or already consumed. 5. Verify that authorization nonce consumption happens atomically with code delegation. 6. Check for race conditions where parallel transactions could replay the same authorization.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0049, Trust Boundary: tb-022. Nonce validation prevents same-chain authorization replay attacks.

checklist.title: Verify Execution Client Validates Authorization Before Granting Code Delegation Privileges

reachability.notes: EIP-7702 allows code delegation for EOAs. Weak authorization validation enables account takeover.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Trace the execution flow from transaction receipt to code delegation state change. 2. Verify that ALL validation checks (signature, chain_id, nonce) complete successfully BEFORE any state modification. 3. Check for time-of-check-to-time-of-use (TOCTOU) vulnerabilities between validation and delegation. 4. Verify that failed validations result in transaction rejection without partial state changes. 5. Test with transactions containing multiple authorizations where some are valid and some are invalid - verify correct handling.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0049, Supporting node check for actor-execution-client. Verifies the execution engine enforces validation before privilege grant.

checklist.title: Verify External User Cannot Forge Authorization for Another Account

reachability.notes: EIP-7702 allows code delegation for EOAs. Weak authorization validation enables account takeover.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. As an attacker account, attempt to create an authorization tuple claiming to be from a victim account. 2. Submit SetCodeTransaction with the forged authorization and verify rejection. 3. Test edge cases: a) empty signature fields, b) signature from attacker's key but claiming victim's address, c) malleated signatures. 4. Verify the signature recovery correctly identifies the actual signer. 5. Attempt known ECDSA attacks (signature malleability, recovery ID manipulation) against the authorization validation.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0049, Supporting node check for actor-external-user and actor-authorizer interaction. PoC goal: demonstrate forged signature acceptance.

filtering_details.justification: Receipt transparency is by design. The devp2p protocol does not provide confidentiality. This is expected behavior in Ethereum's transparency model, not a security vulnerability.
